name: Reclined Butterfly

frames.label: Prepare
frames.cue: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.

frames.label: Open Knees
frames.cue: Bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees open gently.

frames.label: Settle
frames.cue: Relax your hips and support the thighs if needed.

frames.label: Hold
frames.cue: Stay within a comfortable range without pressing the knees down.

frames.label: Close Knees
frames.cue: Use your hands if needed and bring your knees together slowly.

frames.label: Reset
frames.cue: Return both feet to a comfortable neutral position.

safety: Never press the knees toward the floor.
Place pillows beneath the thighs if the hips or groin feel strained.
Reduce the range or stop for sharp groin, hip, knee or lower-back pain.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did Reclined Butterfly feel? Note hip, groin, knee or lower-back comfort and whether you needed support.
